content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need to connect two pH sensors with 4-20 mA output to [product_name] on analog input 1 and analog input 2. The signals are active and the sensor outputs 24V. I'm unsure about the correct wiring and whether a resistor is needed. Could someone advise? Thank you!
You can use a signal converter with 4-20 mA input and 0-10V output to match the analog inputs.
Alternatively, use a 500 Ohm, 0.5 Watt resistor between the analog input and ground for each sensor. Note: The measured value at [product_name] will be between 2 and 10 Volts.
